purpose: Descriptive representation research on real observations; no forecasting labels, trading, or neural training
usage: Personal non-production research; Binance attribution and terms apply; no production rights presumed
missing: No imputation; reset context after gaps; H4 requires four complete UTC-aligned H1 parents; v1.1 excludes and separately audits early-closing source candles from fixed-H1 comparison
amendment: Initial acquisition stopped on 2021-02-11 03:00 UTC BTCUSDT candle closing before the hour. No representation metrics computed. v1 preserved. v1.1 excludes early-close candles without imputation and reports them separately; timestamps outside their stated hour still fail. Also derives split dates from protocol and validates reconstructed finiteness.
sigma: Population standard deviation of last 64 fully past close-to-close log returns; 65 previous contiguous bars required; floor 0.000001
volume_reference: Median of 64 strictly previous contiguous base-asset volumes; floor 0.000000000001
common_side_information: previous true close for local reconstruction

codecs.fixed: Nearest-even rounding: step 0.001 for g,b,u,d and 0.05 for v; unbounded integer symbols
codecs.quantile64: Per-field zero symbol plus at most 63 quantile bins on nonzero calibration values pooled over assets, separately per timeframe; unique internal quantile boundaries; calibration median per occupied bin; open exterior bins; out-of-range support audited
codecs.signs: g,b signs and u,d,v zero/nonzero presence; calibration median of each nonzero category
codecs.adaptive: Nearest-even rounding: step 0.1 past sigma for g,b,u,d and 0.05 for v; observed past sigma supplied as side information; unbounded integer symbols

metrics: local OHLC absolute log error in basis points, mean/p50/p95/p99/max
absolute relative volume error when V>0; zero case separately
tail error for absolute body above training 99th percentile
symbol occupancy and unseen tuple share as description only
cumulative conditional codec drift with true anchor only at development segment start and observed side information
events: Separate close-only level diagnostic: delta=0.005 log, one aggregated crossing per observed close, signed integer steps, duration, residual; no intrabar path; segment-end no-event time right-censored
selection: No winning language or predictive performance declared by reconstruction alone; no repeated tuning of this frozen comparison
statistical_scope: Eight correlated crypto pairs at one venue, convenience sample, no confidence claim of cross-market universality; H1 and H4 share parents
future: Neural VQ, forecasting, calibration of probabilities, multi-market transfer, net-of-cost execution and final holdout evaluation are not performed in POC0
